sections.name: goal
sections.value: Build PRD 003 in an order where the daemon can first tell who is calling (req-10), then decide who may message whom.

value.title: Seat identity provenance: route inventory, capability bootstrap, then gated routes
value.done_when: Every route the checked route inventory lists as seat-authority refuses a caller that holds the daemon key but not the target seat's incarnation capability, with a regression per route class; the inventory sensor passes at the shipping head. Plan 221 is phase 1 (the inventory sensor and the capability-bootstrap workshop); later phases are planned from the workshop.

value.title: Only the recorded prime, the operator or an audited --force sets or retires the prime
value.done_when: A seat that isn't the recorded prime is refused set and retire with nothing written; the recorded prime and an audited --force succeed; a self-designation attempt is refused; every set and retire writes one spine event with the actor and reason.

value.title: A seat's messaging policy: open by default, can be locked down, changed by its parent or prime
value.done_when: A new seat can message any seat; a seat locked to a set can message only that set; its parent or the prime changes the policy, anyone else (and the seat itself) needs --force with a reason, audited. Waits on q-02 (inbound or outbound) before it starts.

value.title: The daemon enforces it: parent and prime reachable, actionable refusals, senders told, replies and outputs included, no new cost
value.done_when: A locked-down seat always reaches its parent and the prime; a refused send names the policy and the way to get it changed; a sender learns when the recipient can't reply to it; replies and outputs follow the same rule; the cost backpressure row shows no new per-tick or per-seat launch. Waits on q-03 and q-04 before it starts.

value.title: Roles carry a default messaging policy
value.done_when: Assigning a role whose definition carries a default policy applies it to the holder's seat, and releasing the holding restores the seat's own policy.

value.change: Created with PRD 003 (#112) so the coverage sensor sees every requirement delivered by a planned step. req-10 first (plan 221); the permission steps wait on Jordan's q-02 to q-04. Owner pm-001 until the prime gives it a PM of its own.
